programs.program_name_en: General Intermediate Diploma In Applied Computing and Network Technologies
programs.official_evidence: Existing bilingual reconciliation contains level and course-description occurrences for ACNT 110 and ACNT 230.
programs.blocker: Complete signatures conflict: ACNT 110 is Operating Systems/نظم التشغيل in the level plan but Programming Fundamentals/أساسيات البرمجة in course descriptions; ACNT 230 is Windows Server/خادم ويندوز in the level plan but Routing and Switching/التوجيه والتبديل in course descriptions. They cannot be collapsed.

programs.official_evidence: The official bilingual program pages place JCOM 651 Research Methods in Digital Media at level 2 for 3 credits, while level-4 JCOM 698 Research Project explicitly lists COM 651 as its prerequisite.
programs.blocker: No authoritative COM 651 course entry was found. Treating the explicit COM 651 prerequisite as JCOM 651 would require correcting official academic data by inference.

programs.official_evidence: Official bilingual program pages confirm the four-level plan, but do not provide authoritative course entries for LAGD 260 or LAPD 150.
programs.blocker: LAGD 261 and LAPD 250 have unresolved prerequisite references in the reconciled plan; exact title, credits, placement, and requisite metadata for LAGD 260 and LAPD 150 remain unavailable.

programs.official_evidence: The official level table references CS 121 from SEC 342, CS 351 from CS 341, and IT 211 plus IT 203 from IT 361.
programs.blocker: The official program page contains no authoritative course records or placements for CS 121, CS 351, IT 203, or IT 211; shared-code titles therefore cannot be reconciled without inference.

programs.program_name_en: Academic General Master of Public Law
programs.official_evidence: The official page states 5 mandatory courses (15 credits), 2 internal electives (6 credits), and 1 external elective (3 credits), and lists the eight optional course identities.
programs.blocker: The eight options are not assigned to explicit semesters, and the current planner schema cannot represent separate internal/external elective pools and selection counts without counting every option as required.

programs.official_evidence: The official page places one generic ELECTIVE row in level 3 and separately lists ACCT 617, ACCT 623, ACCT 624, and ACCT 628 as elective options.
programs.blocker: The page does not explicitly state the required selection count or individually assign options to level 3; the current planner schema cannot encode the pool without treating all four options as required.

programs.program_name_en: Master of Science in Information Systems
programs.official_evidence: The official bilingual pages list three elective options separately from the four-level course plan.
programs.blocker: No explicit required selection count or semester placement for the options is provided, and the current planner schema cannot represent the elective pool accurately.

programs.program_name_en: Professional Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence
programs.official_evidence: The official pages list EMAI 621, 642, 643, 644, 651, 652, 653, 660, and 661 in a non-level elective pool.
programs.blocker: No explicit selection count or semester placement is provided; the current planner schema cannot represent the pool. The English official record also reports EMAI 661 as 30 credits, so its exact credit value cannot be safely normalized.
